description:
FILED s506f (Opus, s507 resume, 2026-10-04).  PRE-EXISTING (main 2e71d4aa identical).

    perl -e 'BEGIN { 1 } -e _; print "x\n"'   -> x
    pcl  -e 'BEGIN { 1 } -e _; print "x\n"'   -> Undefined subroutine &main::e called (status 255)

PPI 1.291 tokens: Word[BEGIN] { Number[1] } Operator[-] Word[e] Magic[_] ;  -- the PPI bug is logged as
docs/ppi-upstream-bugs.md §35 + docs/ppi-bug-report.t.  s506f's switch prefix (`BEGIN { $^W = 1; } ` put on the
program's first code line) hit exactly this shape: `pcl -w -e '-T _'` died (op/filetest.t row "no uninit warnings
from -T with no preceding stat"); the prefix now ends in `; ` (PCLSwitches::prefix_first_code_line), so the
SWITCH path is fixed and guarded (Pl/t/pcl-switches-01.t).  What remains is source WRITTEN this way.
Fix shape: a `_repair_*` token pass, keyed like §21's (adjacency `-` + one-letter filetest Word after a `}` that
closes a BEGIN/END/INIT/CHECK/UNITCHECK block or a compound statement's block), merging into Operator(-X).
subject: A filetest right after a `BEGIN { … }` block on the same line (`BEGIN { 1 } -e _;`) is compiled as minus a call to sub `e` -- PPI 1.291 splits it (docs/ppi-upstream-bugs.md §35); dies "Undefined subroutine &main::e"
